summary: Sandy bush-edge verge on Fleming Road; homes about 25 m across the road.
reasons: Small sandy verge, no tracks seen

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind; nearest mapped houses 44 m from the ring, about 25 m from the verge across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare sandy patch meets the road edge; small, no vehicles or tyre tracks visible.
drivers.traffic: Through road with parked cars further north; light residential traffic.
drivers.convention: No campers or vans seen; a mapped car park lies 39 m away.

flags: Steep: about 7% mean grade around the ring
Powerline runs along the bush edge
Ring itself sits in thick bush, not drivable
sun_shade: Tree canopy over most of it; shaded from the east by bush, open to the west over the road.
cannot_judge: Whether the sandy patch is firm enough for a van

best_section.where: Sandy bare patch on the bush side of Fleming Road, just south-east of the side-street junction, west of the ring
